findings.documented: The collection total represents the available records.
findings.actual: The API reported total 3336, but complete offset pagination returned 3500 unique records.
findings.how_found: Fetched the complete collection with offset pagination until an empty page and compared the unique record count with the API-reported total.
findings.impact: Using the API total as the dataset size can undercount records and produce incorrect analytics or pagination.

findings.documented: Collection pagination is documented with page/limit parameters.
findings.actual: The running API is reliably retrieved with offset/limit; page/skip behavior is not reliable and responses are capped at 50 records.
findings.how_found: Compared documented pagination with live API behavior while fetching the complete collection.
findings.impact: A client using page-based pagination can miss records or stop before the complete dataset is retrieved.

findings.documented: The login response documentation describes a token field.
findings.actual: The running API returns access_token and refresh_token fields.
findings.how_found: Verified the live login response used by the fetcher.
findings.impact: Reading token instead of access_token prevents authentication from working against the running API.

findings.documented: The documented listing detail route differs from the running route.
findings.actual: The running API serves listing details from the plural /v1/listings/{listing_id} route.
findings.how_found: Verified the detail route against the running API.
findings.impact: Using the wrong route causes listing detail requests to fail.

findings.documented: Saved/favourite endpoint documentation differs from the running API contract.
findings.actual: The running API uses GET /v1/saved, POST /v1/saved with listing_id, and DELETE /v1/saved/{id}.
findings.how_found: Verified the live saved-listing endpoints used by the frontend client.
findings.impact: Using the documented contract can break saved-listing persistence.

findings.documented: Analytics summary is documented as an available endpoint.
findings.actual: The running API returned 404 for /v1/analytics/summary, so the assignment analytics are computed locally from the complete datasets.
findings.how_found: Requested the documented endpoint against the running API and received HTTP 404.
findings.impact: The frontend cannot depend on the documented analytics endpoint and needs a local analytics implementation.

findings.actual: 83 duplicate property fingerprint groups were found across 166 listing records.
findings.how_found: Constructed the assignment property fingerprint and grouped listings by property identity rather than listing_id.
findings.impact: Treating every listing_id as a unique property can overcount inventory in property-level analytics.

findings.documented: Project total_listings is expected to agree with the listings associated with the project.
findings.actual: 295 projects have total_listings values that disagree with the actual listing count computed from the complete listings dataset.
findings.how_found: Grouped all fetched listings by project_id and compared each count with projects.total_listings.
findings.impact: Project inventory counts shown in the UI can be incorrect.
